description: Write packages/captions/COMPETITOR_ANALYSIS.md and produce the final decoded comparison. Fully decode the v2 MP4 and compare it against all three competitor references and the v1 full render, generate packages/captions/full-render-v2/comparison-sheet.jpg, and author the honest analysis document (source hashes, methodology, per-reference timestamped shot analysis, quantitative comparison table, old S7 score by category out of 10, redesigned target score, techniques adopted at a general level, techniques intentionally NOT copied for originality/IP, and the exact acceptance targets). Score v2 only after inspecting the complete decoded output; do not inflate. Depends on FEAT-001 (competitor decode artifacts) and FEAT-003 (v2 render + verification.json).
steps: Decode the v2 MP4 entirely (every frame + full audio) using the installed ffmpeg. Reuse the analysis approach/script from FEAT-001 so v2 is measured on the same axes as competitors: composition/cut count and duration distribution (avg/median shot, fraction <2s), camera-translation frame rate, zoom-activity frame rate, dynamic-visual-frame rate, teacher/door visibility windows, performance-motion metrics (from FEAT-003 verification.json plus decoded confirmation), caption face-safety, VFX visibility, and audio metrics (overall WPM, speech-only WPM, median pause, pauses>0.70s, % true silence — the VO is unchanged so these match the approved 158.7/185.7 WPM, median 0.55s, five pauses>0.70s, ~10.2% silence).

Generate packages/captions/full-render-v2/comparison-sheet.jpg: a contact/comparison sheet placing representative decoded v2 frames alongside representative competitor frames and v1 frames (competitor frames are analysis-only, used to illustrate general pacing/cinematography principles, NOT copied assets). Keep the source competitor stills out of git (only the derived comparison-sheet.jpg, which must not reproduce competitor branded assets/characters/UI/logos — use v2's own frames as the primary content and keep competitor references minimal/transformed for pacing illustration, or represent competitor pacing as charts rather than their footage to stay clear of trade dress).

Author packages/captions/COMPETITOR_ANALYSIS.md with: (1) source hashes + technical properties for the voice MP3 and all three competitor MP4s (from FEAT-001); (2) methodology (full-decode frame + audio analysis, deterministic); (3) full timestamped shot/cut analysis for all three references covering framing, camera, zoom, movement, expressions, gestures, VFX, captions, transitions, audio, pacing; (4) a quantitative comparison table (competitors vs old S7 vs redesigned v2): composition count, avg/median shot, translation%, zoom%, dynamic%, WPM, pauses; (5) old S7 score by category out of 10 using the honest v1 baseline to verify: story/VO sync 7, captions/readability 8, camera variety 3, camera movement/zoom 2.5, character acting 3, facial performance 4, environment/prop specificity 4, teacher/door narrative fidelity 1, VFX/impact 5, audio technical 8, pacing/retention 4, overall ~4.5-5; (6) redesigned target score per category; (7) techniques adopted at a GENERAL level (fast semantic cutting, reaction close-ups, OTS, prop inserts, action-contact punch-ins, low-angle reveal, two-shot contrast, consequence wides, scale reveal, impact shake, anticipation) NOT copied shots; (8) techniques intentionally NOT copied due to originality/IP (no competitor characters, branded assets, maps, UI, logos, footage, or trade dress); (9) the exact acceptance targets used by the render gates.

Score v2 AFTER inspecting the decoded output and record the new per-category and overall score honestly next to v1 in the doc, plus remaining gaps (e.g. the VO remains slower than competitors by design; retention improvements come from visual acting + cuts + event SFX, not from altering the approved VO).
Run `npm run typecheck` (doc-only change should not affect it) and re-run node packages/captions/tools/verify-mvp.ts to confirm v1 golden hashes still pass.
acceptance_criteria: packages/captions/COMPETITOR_ANALYSIS.md exists and contains: source hashes+properties, methodology, per-reference timestamped shot analysis for all three competitors, a quantitative comparison table, old S7 per-category+overall score out of 10, redesigned target score, adopted general techniques, intentionally-not-copied IP-sensitive techniques, and exact acceptance targets.
packages/captions/full-render-v2/comparison-sheet.jpg exists, is derived from the decoded v2 (and v1) render, and does not reproduce competitor branded assets/characters/UI/logos/trade dress.

The v2 score is recorded after inspecting the complete decoded output and is presented alongside v1 (old vs new) with honest remaining gaps; v2 is measurably better than v1 on camera variety/movement/zoom, character acting, facial performance, and teacher/door fidelity.
No competitor MP4 or raw voice MP3 is committed.
verification: Confirm packages/captions/COMPETITOR_ANALYSIS.md and packages/captions/full-render-v2/comparison-sheet.jpg exist and open, and the doc contains the comparison table + old-vs-new scores + adopted/not-copied technique sections + acceptance targets.
Run `node packages/captions/tools/verify-mvp.ts` and confirm the v1 full-render hash checks still pass.
Run `git status --porcelain` and confirm no .scratch/ media is staged.

findings.summary: Decoded v1 and v2 MP4s on the SAME axes as the three competitor references, authored packages/captions/COMPETITOR_ANALYSIS.md, and produced packages/captions/full-render-v2/comparison-sheet.jpg (real 1080x2147 JPEG). v2 scored honestly AFTER decoding: overall ~7.4/10 vs v1 ~4.5-5, measurably better on camera variety/movement/zoom, character acting, facial performance and teacher/door fidelity. v1 golden untouched; typecheck + verify-mvp still pass.

decoded_render_measurement.script: scripts/render-visual-analysis.mjs (reuses competitor-visual-analysis.mjs pipeline: scene-detect cuts + mean-abs luma motion). Output .scratch/visual-analysis/render-summary.json.
decoded_render_measurement.v1: 39 decoded shots, avg 1.774s, median 1.633s, translationFrameRate 0.122, zoomFrameRate 0.0564.
decoded_render_measurement.v2: 33 decoded shots, avg 2.096s, median 1.80s, translationFrameRate 0.2329, zoomFrameRate 0.1557 (roughly 2x v1 on both).
decoded_render_measurement.note: Decoded hard-cut count (33) is below the solver composition count (41) because many v2 compositions are continuous camera moves (dolly/push-in/arc/punch-in), not hard cuts. This is documented honestly in the analysis; both lenses are reported.

comparison_sheet.how: scripts/build-comparison-sheet.mjs extracts decoded v1/v2 frames via ffmpeg, lays them out in HTML, screenshots with installed Chromium (/opt/playwright/chromium-1232) to a real JPEG. ffmpeg-static lacks drawtext/libfreetype so ffmpeg tiling was not usable for text; Chromium screenshot chosen instead.
comparison_sheet.content: Primary = v2's own 8 decoded story-beat frames + a v1-vs-v2 old-vs-new strip at matched moments. Competitor influence shown ONLY as derived numeric pacing charts (cuts/min, translation%, zoom%, median shot). NO competitor characters/maps/UI/logos/footage. Verified JPEG 1080x2147 via `file`.
comparison_sheet.ip: Raw competitor stills kept out of git (.scratch/). Confirmed no .scratch media staged.

scores.biggest_gains: teacher/door fidelity 1->8.5, camera movement/zoom 2.5->7.5, camera variety 3->7.5, character acting 3->7.5, facial performance 4->7.

findings.remaining_gaps: Approved VO stays slower than competitors by design (158.7 overall / 185.7 speech-only WPM, median pause 0.55s, five pauses>0.70s, ~10.2% silence vs ~199-211 WPM / ~1-3% silence). Retention gains are from visual acting + cuts + event SFX, not VO edits. Env/prop specificity 6/10 and decoded cut cadence (median 1.8s) intentionally slower than fastest reference (1.13s).
findings.verification: npm run typecheck PASS; node packages/captions/tools/verify-mvp.ts exit 0 (v1 golden hashes intact, gates 47/47, faceConflicts 0, music none); v1 mp4 sha256 unchanged 6317404e...afe28; git status --porcelain shows no .scratch/ media staged.
findings.committed: packages/captions/COMPETITOR_ANALYSIS.md, packages/captions/full-render-v2/comparison-sheet.jpg, scripts/render-visual-analysis.mjs, scripts/build-comparison-sheet.mjs, and the FEAT-004.json task-state update. FEAT-003 intermediates (audio-report.json/caption-placements.json/mix.wav/probe.json) left uncommitted as in FEAT-003.
